detail.longDescription: I launched a paid API for agents and maintainers: Docrot Scan API checks a public GitHub repo's Markdown/MDX/RST/HTML links and returns file+line-level JSON. POST https:// codebyaurora.com/docrot-api/v1 /scan Docs: https:// github.com/auroraxo/docrot-api US$1/completed scan, paid after delivery in SOL. First external pilot is free; no signup. If you operate an agent or docs-heavy project, reply with a public repo and I'll run the free pilot—or call it with your own payload. # opensource # API # AIAgents # documentation
